title: The vehicles in the level, loot or not
target: The vehicles in R.E.P.O. and which of them are loot: a car and a plane that are valuables, a snow bike built to be ridden out, and a tricycle that arrives as a monster with a rider.
version: 0.4.0, read from the copy of the game this site was built from (see the sources page)
prerequisites: A route back to the extractor that a vehicle can take
A crew that knows which of you is driving
Room to put a plane down again

steps.do: Expect some vehicles in a level to be valuables you can carry out.
steps.because: the car, the plane and the snow bike are each defined as a valuable, with the usual trap states and rarity level for going off (ValuableCar, ValuablePlane, ValuableArcticSnowBike, trapTriggered, trapActivateRarityLevel)

steps.do: Look at a car's parts before you decide how to move it.
steps.because: it has a body, front and rear wheels, a driver with a body and arms, and a curve for each of them (carBody, wheelsFront, wheelsBack, driverBody, driverArms, carBodyCurve)

steps.do: Listen to a car before you trust it to sit still.
steps.because: it has sounds for the horn and for starting, stopping and running (sfxCarHorn, sfxCarStart, sfxCarStop, sfxCarLoop)

steps.do: Expect a car to handle differently once it is moving.
steps.because: it carries two physical materials, one for standing still and one for moving (defaultPhysicMaterial, movingPhysicMaterial)

steps.do: Do not expect a plane to stay on the ground if it is going fast.
steps.because: the plane takes off according to speed, with a lift per unit of speed and a maximum lift force, and it has a cruising speed and a flight speed (takeOffSpeed, liftPerSpeed, maxLiftForce, cruiseSpeed, flightSpeed)

steps.do: Look for the seat if you intend to ride a snow bike out.
steps.because: the snow bike has a seat, a look-at point and a steering transform (seatTransform, lookAtTransform, steeringTransform)

steps.do: Expect a snow bike to keep a state and a timer, like the machines.
steps.because: it has a state, a timer with a maximum and a rigid body of its own, along with an engine loop (currentState, stateTimer, stateTimerMax, audioEngineLoop)

steps.do: Treat a tricycle as a monster rather than as loot.
steps.because: the tricycle arrives with a rider and the game keeps the two together as one monster (EnemyTricycle, bikeRiderTransforms, visuals)

steps.do: Know that its approach is announced, including a bell heard across the level.
steps.because: it has a bell, a bell heard across the level, a final build-up and a warning given before it acts (audioBell, audioBellGlobal, audioFinalBellBuildup, audioTell, audioTellGlobal)

steps.do: Watch the rider's rig, because the wheels shake on a spring of their own.
steps.because: the rig has wheels and handlebars kept as their own kind of object, with a body, a bell and a pedal crank transform, and the wheels shake on a spring with its own speed and damping (wheels, TricycleHandlebars, pedalCrankTransform, wheelShakeSpringSpeed, wheelShakeSpringDamping)

commonMistakes: Treating a car or a plane as a crate and finding out what it does when it starts.
Assuming a snow bike is scenery when it has a seat and steering.
Trying to carry the tricycle out instead of getting out of its way.
Ignoring the bell, which is the monster telling you where it is.
sources: A local copy of the game, read only. Grounding for each step is on the technical reference pages; no number is estimated.
